_about: The website's Racials page (build_spell_data.py writes racial-tooltips.json from this). Each race lists its racial skill line in SkillLineAbility.dbc; the page shows every racial a Wildcard character gets from it, plus the signature passive's spellbook entry and the buffs it shows. 'changed' says in our own words what Wildcard changed (keep it in step with docs/race-kits.md and CHANGES.md); 'replaced' are stock racials a signature passive replaces, left off the page; 'note' is a plain hint. Texts are ours: never client text.

changed.20594: Stronger: the buff lasts 10 sec (was 8) and gives +20% armour and resistance to every magic school, about 8% less spell damage taken. 2 min cooldown.

changed.20589: Also gives 60% more movement speed for 3 sec (Overclock).

changed.59542: No longer on the global cooldown, and fills Radiant Presence's Light to 5 at once.

changed.33697: Also adds a stack of Rush (Bloodrush).

changed.7744: No longer on the global cooldown.
changed.20577: Reworked: a 2.5 sec channel (was 10 sec) that restores every resource as well as health, leaves you Gorged when it finishes, and builds Grave Feast for Grave Defiance. No longer on the global cooldown.

changed.20549: Can be cast while moving (you slow down while it casts), and adds 30% to Plainsrunning for 5 sec.

changed.26297: Scales with missing health: 10% haste at full health up to 30% at 40% health or lower (was a flat 20%).

changed.28730: 1 min cooldown (was 2 min). It eats your Arcane Hunger stacks to restore 2% of every resource per stack, then you are Satiated for 15 sec.
